name: マネーフォワード クラウド
description: Business connector for マネーフォワード クラウド請求書 (invoicing) through its public API v3 with the customer's own app. Read-only, always: billings, quotes and partners. Only the read scope mfc/invoice/data.read is requested.

clientId.description: Client ID of the app on the Money Forward Cloud developer portal. The client secret goes in the secret store: connector.money-forward.clientSecret.

clientAuth.description: Client authentication method shown on the app's detail screen: CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC (basic) or CLIENT_SECRET_POST (post).

redirectPort.description: Loopback port of the redirect URI registered on the app (http://localhost:<port>/callback).
